name: Tier list
what: A tier list of glass drops in under your chin (beside you on a wide frame) with a title above your head: the S / A / B / C labels pop in, the items already ranked slide into A, B and C, then your item pops in beside you and flies on an arc into the S tier - it lands with a squash, a burst of dots and the S label flashing. The board floats while it holds and sinks away at the end.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f0-f12 the board drops in from 90 px higher, growing from 94 % (slow end, a small overshoot, seen within 3 f) while the title rises 26 px into place (f2-f14); the S / A / B / C labels pop in from 30 % (8 f each, 3 f apart from f4) and their tracks wipe open (10 f); the ranked items slide in from the left (8 f each, 3 f apart from f12); f24-f32 the item pops in beside the chin at 1.15x (slow end, overshoot) and wobbles; f36-f54 it flies on a 120 px arc into the S slot (S-curve); f54 it lands with a squash (9 f), a burst of 8 dots (12 f) and the S label flashing and swelling (14 f); then the S label glows (a 40 f breath), a light crosses the tile every 48 f, the board floats 3 px and a band of light crosses the glass (f58-f82, S-curve); the last 9 f it sinks 30 px and fades (accelerating)
